newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-DYNAMO OVERPOWER CSKA, ALANIA HIT FIVE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DYNAMO OVERPOWER CSKA, ALANIA HIT FIVE.

text.p: A goal in each half settled Sunday's Moscow derby in favour of Dynamo over CSKA on the first day of the Russian premier league season.

A heavy snowfall cut short the capital's early spring for the occasion, reminding the powers-that-be in Russian soccer of the climatic obstacles they face in their attempts to bring their calender into line with the European winter game.

Andrei Gordeyev and Oleg Terekhin secured the points for Dynamo against a CSKA side totally transformed by the departure of coach Alexander Tarkhanov and much of his squad to Torpedo Moscow in the close season.
Champions Spartak Moscow, playing without the injured Andrei Tikhonov and several other first team choices, did just enough to overcome Zhemchuzhina 1-0 in Sochi.
Last year's runners-up Alania served notice of their potential with a thumping 5-0 victory over KamAZ in front of 34,000 home fans in Vladikavkaz.
